hack.protocol_name: Fortress Protocol (lending arm of JetFuel Finance)
hack.description: Fortress Protocol was drained for $3M when an attacker passed a malicious governance proposal (active for 3 days, uncontested) and exploited a publicly callable oracle to inflate FTS price, using $4.50 worth of FTS as collateral to borrow everything.
